subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be resolved as docs/help for the existing pi-tui Shift+Enter behavior, or should OpenClaw add a supported TUI send/newline keybinding configuration surface?
rationale: OpenClaw already gets basic newline insertion from pi-tui, but exposing `enterSends` or equivalent keybinding configuration would create a new public config surface under a repo policy that keeps config additions high-bar.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior
options.body: Update docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, backslash-enter fallback, and terminal caveats, while leaving configurable keybindings for a separate sponsored design.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Config
options.body: Define a narrow `tui.input` keybinding contract, wire it into pi-tui, and add config/schema/docs plus focused fresh-install and upgrade tests.

options.title: Decline Additional Surface
options.body: Treat pi-tui's default Shift+Enter support as sufficient and explicitly close the request for configurable send/newline behavior.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior
recommendation.body: Update docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, backslash-enter fallback, and terminal caveats, while leaving configurable keybindings for a separate sponsored design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent TUI docs/product history and already framed the remaining decision on this issue.
